purpose: Continue the pretrained TRIAGE-Fuse model with an OSA-conditioned T-MEB specialization while preserving the L1-L2-L3 protein-interaction backbone.
allowed_training_data: GSE71356 frozen primary IH crossover samples

cross_validation.GSE75097: deterministic stratified leave-one-fold-out context construction within PS, MSO and VSO
cross_validation.GSE71356: leave-one-subject-out context construction across the four crossover subjects; a one-subject effect is never used as the validation or test gold standard
cross_validation.train_val_test: train, validation and test pairs are protein-disjoint; each outer fold builds all weak targets from the approximately three-quarter development participants only, while the held-out participant fold is used solely for direction/stability audit

trainable_innovation.weak_supervision: continuous discovery-only pair priority derived from fold-specific OSA severity and IH node evidence

checkpoint_selection: validation soft-label BCE and rank correlation on a protein-disjoint validation partition; all fold targets are constructed only from development participants, and held-out participants are stability audits rather than gold labels
final_epoch_rule: median cross-validation best epoch; fixed before fitting all discovery data
